answer.reason: Only DAN 11:11 tells one deed of the king of the south who is named in verse 5; the other marked verses concern other kings of the same title or give no deed.

clauses.english: was moved with anger and fought the king of the north, and his multitude was given into his hand
clauses.quote: shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north

doubts: DAN 11:14, 11:25 and 11:40 name a king of the south, but they may speak of a later king with the same title, so they are left out.
DAN 11:9 only says he came into his kingdom and returned to his land, so it is left out.
The verses are a prophecy in the future tense, and the clause turns it into the past tense.
